lint.description: Oxlint (no type-aware pass — tsc already covers types)

refs.description: Citation scanner — flags a bare, mislinked, or unglossed D#/C# tag

prose.description: Vale over the prose we own and can edit (docs, README, src doc comments); voice anchored to docs/voice/
prose.note: Two narrowings, both deliberate. (1) The path list replaces the adapter's bare `.`: vale reads no .gitignore and skips no hidden directory, so `.` would sweep node_modules/, dist/, and the two record surfaces nothing may rewrite, CHANGELOG.md and .plumbbob/builds/. `skills/` is the one owned path left out, and not by choice: vale parses markdown frontmatter as YAML, every SKILL.md description carries an unquoted colon, and one E201 abandons the entire run. Parked, not forgotten. (2) `optIn: true` holds the slot out of the default run until its first findings are burned down by hand, which is the next planned step. The findings are fixed, never baselined, and a red slot in the default run would refuse the very checkpoints that clean it up; the refs scanner above was staged the same way, authored first and wired last. Reach it meanwhile with `--only prose`.

test.description: Runs alone (order: single) — the suite saturates every core, so no other check shares its wave

gate.note: vitest is ~53s of the ~56s full check — the per-turn Stop-hook gate skips it; `pnpm check` / checkpoint still run it
